title: Swiss Beauty Select targets Rs 100 crore as premium beauty arm charts 100 pc plus growth
summary: Swiss Beauty Select is projected to achieve over 100% growth, aiming for revenues exceeding Rs 70 crore by FY26-27. With a target of reaching Rs 100 crore in FY27-28, the brand emphasizes skincare-infused makeup for evolving consumer needs. Expansion includes increasing its product portfolio by introducing new child SKUs and offline retail outlets. Currently, the company's channel mix is 70% offline and 30% online, transitioning to a 65:35 split.
